====================================================================================================
1. PRODUCT PURPOSE AND WHAT THE USER SEES
====================================================================================================
English: This is an assessment/demo of browser-based AI customer support for Aura Skincare. The customer opens one Next.js page, sees three fictional orders, presses Start call, allows microphone access, hears Aria's greeting, and asks questions aloud. Aria supports brand policies and order questions in English. The page shows state changes, a timer, microphone status, a chronological conversation and an end-of-call structured outcome. Transcript and outcome can be downloaded as JSON through local browser Blob URLs.

The product does not dial telephone numbers. There is no PSTN, Twilio, phone recording service, database, login, real e-commerce order mutation or courier integration in this code. A call is a browser microphone/speaker session over one WebSocket. Order lookup and standard-return checking are read-only. If ORD-103 is eligible for cancellation, Aria may explain eligibility but cannot actually cancel it. If a return is eligible, no refund is issued by this implementation.

The main UI is composed in frontend/app/page.tsx. AgentState shows status and duration; CallControls provides start/end and mic meter; Transcript shows final recognized customer text and confirmed played Aria speech; SampleOrders fetches public fixtures independently; ErrorNotice shows readable errors; CallSummary shows summary, resolution, audit, open questions and JSON. Layout imports the global stylesheet and adds title/description. Most frontend behavior lives in useCall and CallAudio, not inside the visual components.
Roman Hindi: Yeh Aura Skincare ke browser-based AI customer support ka assessment/demo project hai. Customer ek Next.js page kholta hai, teen fictional orders dekhta hai, Start call press karta hai, mic permission deta hai, Aria ki greeting sunta hai aur bolkar questions puchhta hai. Aria English mein brand policies aur order questions handle karti hai. Page par state, timer, mic status, chronological conversation aur call ke baad structured outcome dikhte hain. Transcript aur outcome local browser Blob URL se JSON download hote hain.

Product phone number dial nahi karta. Code mein PSTN, Twilio, phone recording service, database, login, actual order mutation ya courier integration nahi hai. Call ka matlab browser mic aur speaker session hai jo ek WebSocket par chalti hai. Order lookup aur standard-return check read-only hain. ORD-103 cancellation eligible ho to Aria sirf eligibility explain kar sakti hai; actual cancel nahi. Return eligible ho tab bhi refund is app se issue nahi hota.

Main UI frontend/app/page.tsx mein compose hoti hai. AgentState status/timer, CallControls start/end aur meter, Transcript final recognized customer text aur played Aria speech, SampleOrders public fixtures, ErrorNotice readable errors aur CallSummary summary/JSON dikhata hai. Layout global CSS aur metadata add karta hai. Actual call behavior useCall aur CallAudio mein hai; visual components sirf state aur controls ko present karte hain.

2. STACK, FOLDERS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
====================================================================================================
English: Frontend: the manifest declares Next 16.4.0, React/React DOM 19.3.0, Tailwind 4.3.3, TypeScript ^5.9.3, Phosphor icons and Playwright ^1.58.2. These are local project declarations, not an assertion that these are today's recommended/latest releases. Next App Router uses app/layout.tsx and app/page.tsx. React hooks own the browser call lifecycle. AudioWorklet runs mic batching on the audio thread, while Web Audio buffers schedule speaker playback. Native fetch loads HTTP data; native WebSocket carries call events and binary audio.

Backend: FastAPI exposes two GET routes and one WebSocket; Uvicorn serves the ASGI app. Pydantic validates settings, client events, tool arguments, transcript entries and structured summary fields. HTTPX sends asynchronous Google Interactions requests. asyncio coordinates background opening/customer tasks, cancellation and playback futures. Python wave/io validate WAV entirely in memory. re normalizes IDs and detects simple sentence boundaries; json serializes model history and fixtures.

backend/app holds implementation; backend/app/data holds orders and policies; backend/tests holds automated tests; backend/.env is private runtime configuration. frontend/app holds page and CSS; components holds presentation; hooks/useCall.ts holds lifecycle; lib/audio.ts holds audio; lib/api.ts holds URL helpers; types/call.ts holds contracts; public/mic-worklet.js holds the audio processor; tests holds browser scenarios. Root Compose and Render YAML plus two Dockerfiles describe run/deploy options. docs records deployment, testing and submission notes.

No external agent framework is used. Agent is this project's own class. There are two tool names, get_order_details and check_return_eligibility. A provider model proposes a tool call, Python validates it and returns a structured function_result, then another model round generates the explanation. New Agents have empty history and cannot read an older Call's messages.

Yeh local project versions hain; latest recommended releases ka claim nahi. Next App Router app/layout.tsx aur app/page.tsx use karta hai. React hooks call lifecycle own karte hain. AudioWorklet audio thread par mic frames batch karta hai; Web Audio speaker playback schedule karta hai. Native fetch HTTP data aur native WebSocket call events/binary audio bhejta hai.

Backend mein FastAPI do GET aur ek WebSocket route expose karta hai; Uvicorn ASGI app serve karta hai. Pydantic settings, events, tool arguments, entries aur outcome validate karta hai. HTTPX async Google requests bhejta hai. Asyncio opening/customer tasks, cancellation aur playback futures coordinate karta hai. Python wave/io WAV ko memory mein validate karte hain. Re IDs normalize aur sentences detect karta hai; json history aur fixtures serialize karta hai.

backend/app implementation, data orders/policies, tests checks aur .env private config rakhta hai. 3. ARCHITECTURE AND DATA MOVEMENT
====================================================================================================
English: Architecture diagram (each arrow is a concrete code boundary):

Customer browser
  Home/page.tsx -> useCall reducer and refs -> CallAudio
  microphone -> AudioContext source -> mic-processor AudioWorklet
  float frames -> RMS endpoint detection -> makeWav -> binary WebSocket
                                      |
FastAPI /ws/call -> Call.accept_audio -> validate_audio -> Call.turn
  -> GeminiVoice.transcribe -> Gemini.create -> Google Interactions
  <- exact JSON {text} -> Customer Entry -> transcript event to browser
  -> Agent.answer -> GeminiLLM.stream -> Gemini.stream SSE
  -> function_call -> run_tool -> orders JSON / Python policy rules
  <- function_result -> next model round -> sentence text
  -> Call.say -> GeminiVoice.speech -> Google streamed TTS
  -> speech_start JSON -> binary 24-kHz PCM -> speech_done JSON
                                      |
Browser CallAudio -> scheduled speaker buffers -> actual node endings
  -> played / playback_failed JSON -> Call.acknowledge
  -> played Aria Entry or interruption marker -> transcript UI

End call -> stop microphone/playback -> end JSON -> Call.stop
  -> cancel task -> summarise -> Outcome validation or factual fallback
  -> ended JSON -> CallSummary and downloadable outcome

HTTP endpoints are independent: GET /health reports config/liveness; GET /orders returns enriched fixtures. Neither route performs a model call. Backend->Google traffic is HTTP/JSON or SSE, while browser->backend call traffic is WebSocket. This is a chained STT -> LLM -> TTS design, not a single continuous native live-audio provider connection. Input is accumulated into complete WAV utterances; output streams PCM sentence by sentence.

There are three distinct evidence stores. Agent.messages is per-call provider history and includes function calls/results and thought signatures. Call.entries is final transcript evidence; Call.tools is the backend tool audit. Browser refs keep only received entries/tools for a disconnect fallback, while reducer state renders them. These stores have related roles but do not contain identical data. A lookup result can be in tools even if the following explanation failed playback.
Roman Hindi: Diagram ke har arrow ka actual code boundary hai. Browser mein Home useCall se state aur controls leta hai. CallAudio mic source ko AudioWorklet se connect karta hai. Float frames par RMS detection, phir makeWav se complete WAV banakar WebSocket par bhejta hai. FastAPI Call.accept_audio se validation aur Call.turn chalata hai. GeminiVoice audio ko text banata hai; Customer Entry transcript mein add hoti hai. Agent model stream padhta hai; tool call aaye to run_tool JSON fixtures aur Python rules use karta hai. Function result next model round ko milta hai aur sentence text aata hai.

Call.say us sentence ki TTS banata hai. Speech_start, binary PCM aur speech_done browser ko jate hain. Browser scheduled audio buffers play karta hai; nodes actually end hone par played ya playback_failed bhejta hai. Call.acknowledge played Aria text ya interruption marker transcript mein add karta hai. End par mic/speaker stop, end event, task cancellation, summary validation ya fallback aur ended outcome milta hai.

GET /health aur /orders independent hain; koi model call nahi chalti. Browser-backend WebSocket hai; backend-Google HTTP/JSON ya SSE hai. Yeh chained STT -> LLM -> TTS hai, ek continuous native live-audio provider connection nahi. Input complete utterance WAV hai; output sentence-by-sentence streamed PCM hai.

Teen evidence stores alag purpose rakhte hain. Agent.messages provider history hai: calls/results aur signatures bhi. Call.entries final transcript aur Call.tools backend audit hai. Browser refs sirf received entries/tools disconnect fallback ke liye rakhte hain; reducer UI render karta hai. Data related hai lekin identical nahi. Tool result audit mein aa sakta hai even agar uski speech explanation playback fail ho gayi.

4. CURRENT CONFIGURATION AND STARTUP WORKFLOW
====================================================================================================
English: Inspected backend/.env has a nonempty GEMINI_API_KEY; its value is intentionally hidden. LLM_MODEL and STT_MODEL are gemini-3.5-flash-lite; TTS_MODEL is gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts; TTS_VOICE is Kore; MAX_SESSIONS is 8; FRONTEND_ORIGINS contains http://localhost:3000 and http://127.0.0.1:3107. frontend/.env.local has NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8107. Nonempty does not prove that the key is valid, quota is available, or named models are currently accessible.

Correct local address combination: backend on 127.0.0.1:8107 and frontend on 127.0.0.1:3107. The browser's exact origin then matches the allowlist. If using a different host/port, align both URL and allowed origin. localhost and 127.0.0.1 are different origins. Opening frontend on localhost:3107 would not match the current list unless added.

First-time setup from root (if dependencies are not already installed):
  python -m venv backend/.venv
  backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
  Copy .env.example only if the active env does not already exist; do not overwrite the saved key.
  In frontend: npm.cmd ci

Terminal 1, working directory backend:
  .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8107 --ws-max-size 5000000
Terminal 2, working directory frontend:
  npm.cmd run dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3107
Browser:
  http://127.0.0.1:3107

Startup execution: Uvicorn imports app.main; its imports load tools.py, which reads fixture JSON. main calls get_settings, constructs FastAPI/CORS and the active_calls set. Next loads config, layout/page, CSS and frontend modules. The server-rendered initial screen is hydrated with client behavior. SampleOrders' effect fetches /orders. No microphone request happens until Start call. Aria's greeting is not preplayed on initial page load.

Saved key/model values are re-read by /health and each new WebSocket. Existing Call adapters keep the values they were created with. HTTP CORS is configured from startup Settings, so changing origins requires restart for CORS; the WebSocket check itself reloads Settings. Orders/policies are read at import time, so fixture edits need process reload. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is public/build-time client configuration; production URL changes require a rebuild.

LLM_MODEL aur STT_MODEL gemini-3.5-flash-lite, TTS_MODEL gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts, voice Kore, sessions 8 aur origins localhost:3000 plus 127.0.0.1:3107 hain. Frontend URL 127.0.0.1:8107 hai. Key nonempty hone se valid key, available quota ya accessible models prove nahi hote.

Next config, layout/page, CSS aur modules load karke client behavior hydrate karta hai. SampleOrders effect /orders fetch karta hai. Start call se pehle mic permission nahi maangi jati aur greeting bhi play nahi hoti.

====================================================================================================
6. AUDIO MATH, FORMATS AND HALF-DUPLEX BEHAVIOR
====================================================================================================
English: Input: browser Float32Array samples typically range around -1 to +1. makeWav clamps each sample and maps it to signed int16: negative *32768, nonnegative *32767. Samples use two bytes, little-endian. WAV includes RIFF/WAVE/fmt/data markers. Header is44 bytes; file length=44+2*N; RIFF chunk size=36+2*N; data size=2*N; mono byte rate=sampleRate*2; block align=2. Input WAV stores the actual AudioContext sample rate; it is not hardcoded to24 kHz.

Detection example at48 kHz: worklet frame2048 samples lasts approximately42.67ms. RMS=sqrt(sum(sample^2)/sampleCount); voice=rms>0.018. Around200ms pre-roll is rounded up to5 frames, about213ms. Ending900ms silence is observed on frame boundaries, not an exact wall-clock sample. At least180ms voiced frames are needed. Detection elapsed caps around20seconds; pre-roll and frame rounding can make total WAV slightly longer, which explains backend validation allowing up to21seconds. This is a fixed energy detector, not neural VAD. Loud noise may look like voice and quiet speech may not cross threshold.

Output: source code expects mono24,000-Hz signed16-bit little-endian PCM with no WAV header. 24,000 samples/sec*2 bytes=48,000 bytes/sec. A4,800-byte chunk is100ms at this expected format. Voice adapter requests audio/l16; the browser decodes each two bytes with getInt16(...,true). MIME text alone does not independently prove an external provider's byte ordering; real-provider compatibility remains a runtime requirement.

A WebSocket frame may end on one byte of a sample. CallAudio stores the odd byte and prepends it to the next packet. Buffer nodes use createBuffer(1,sampleCount,24000); Web Audio performs output-rate handling. Each node starts after both currentTime+20ms and previous queue end. Initial nextTime=currentTime+50ms. There is no continuously extending one buffer; a set tracks many scheduled source nodes.

Half-duplex: while Aria is Speaking/Thinking, customer capture is paused and reset. Echo cancellation is requested and mic monitoring gain=0. Listening starts only after all answer segments finish. There is no barge-in: talking over Aria does not submit a competing turn. End call is the interruption mechanism. The microphone track can stay open while input is paused, but End/unmount permanently stops tracks and closes AudioContext.
Roman Hindi: Input Float32Array sample aam taur par -1 se +1 hota hai. MakeWav clamp karke signed int16 banata hai: negative guna32768 aur baaki guna32767. Do-byte little-endian samples aur RIFF/WAVE/fmt/data header likhta hai. Header44 bytes, file44+2*N, RIFF size36+2*N, data2*N, byte rate sampleRate*2 aur block align2 hai. Input actual AudioContext sample rate rakhta hai, hardcoded24k nahi.

48kHz example mein2048-sample frame lagbhag42.67ms hai. RMS squared samples ka average aur square root hai;0.018 se zyada voice.200ms pre-roll ceil karke5frames yani lagbhag213ms hota hai.900ms silence frame boundaries par detect hoti hai. Minimum180ms voiced frames chahiye.20-second detection cap mein pre-roll/frame rounding se total WAV thodi badi ho sakti hai; backend21seconds allow karta hai. Yeh fixed energy detector hai, neural VAD nahi; noise voice lag sakti hai aur quiet speech miss ho sakti hai.

Output code mono24kHz signed16-bit little-endian PCM expect karta hai; WAV header nahi.24000*2=48000bytes/sec;4800bytes lagbhag100ms. Half-duplex mein Aria bolne/sochne ke waqt customer capture pause aur reset hai. Echo cancellation request aur monitor gain zero. Poora answer finish par Listening. 7. ORDER DATA, POLICY RULES AND EXAMPLE CONVERSATIONS
====================================================================================================
English: 
ORD-101: fictional customer Priya Sharma; Vitamin C Serum (30ml); INR 699; Out for Delivery; BlueDart; tracking BD-982103; fixed note Expected by 6 PM today. Cancellation eligibility is false, with doorstep-refusal advice. No live courier API is called, and today is not recalculated from the current calendar.
ORD-102: fictional customer Rahul Verma; Hydrating Sunscreen SPF 50; INR 499; Delivered; Delhivery; tracking DL-441029; fixed note Delivered 14 days ago. Standard returns are ineligible because 14 > 7. This fixture age overrides a customer claiming delivery was yesterday. Exactly INR 499 shipping is still unspecified.
ORD-103: fictional customer Ananya Patel; Green Tea Face Wash + Toner; INR 850; Processing; fixed note Ordered 3 hours ago. Cancellation eligibility is true, but the order is not cancelled. No courier/tracking fields exist, so the UI omits them. Purchase age is not delivery age.

Cancellation rules: exactly Processing => eligible true. Shipped or Out for Delivery => false, with doorstep-refusal advice. Delivered and all other statuses => false. Comparisons are case-sensitive. The lookup never writes a status update to orders.json.

Standard-return rules are evaluated in order. Confirmed opened => false. Delivery age greater than 7 days => false. Confirmed used => false. Confirmed absent original packaging => false. A known rejection is sufficient even if other facts are missing. Otherwise collect every null fact; any missing fact yields eligible=null and a list of questions. Age at most 7 plus unopened, unused and original_packaging all true => eligible true. Exactly 7 passes; 7.01 fails. Strict booleans reject a string such as 'false'; age is bounded and numeric. A confirmed order not yet Delivered cannot be assessed as a standard delivered-item return. Damage/defect reporting is a separate 48-hour/photos policy; no replacement action tool is implemented.

Shipping knowledge: free strictly above INR 499; INR 50 below INR 499; exactly INR 499 unspecified; delivery wording 3-5 business days. COD knowledge: allowed up to INR 2500 inclusive, with cash or UPI at doorstep. These are JSON/prompt facts, not registered Python shipping/COD calculators. Python cancellation/return constants duplicate the corresponding policy JSON, so future changes must update both consistently.

Example A: Customer asks Where is order one zero one? STT recognizes the words. Agent proposes get_order_details. normalise_order converts individual spoken digits to ORD-101. The result confirms status/courier/note; function_result enters model history; a subsequent round explains it. Only actually played answer segments become Aria transcript entries. Which courier? uses the same call's history and another lookup as instructed. Can I cancel it? receives ineligible advice, with no cancellation execution.

Example B: Can I return ORD-102? Lookup confirms the fourteen-day fixture. check_return_eligibility rejects the seven-day policy, even if the customer supplies a one-day claim. A clearly explained refusal can be RESOLVED because the question was answered. RESOLVED does not mean a cancellation or refund was completed.

Example C: ORD-999 is clear but absent: found=false, order_id=ORD-999, error=not_found. Its lookup attempt can appear in the audit. An ambiguous phrase such as 101 or 103 produces unclear_id, not nearest-order selection. Missing IDs rely on the model's clarification instruction. Tool allowlisting blocks unregistered action execution; deterministic unit tests do not prove all live model phrasing or injection resistance.

8. SESSION STATES, WEBSOCKET CONTRACT AND PLAYBACK TRUTH
====================================================================================================
English: 
Typical state sequence: Idle -> Connecting -> Speaking (greeting) -> Thinking -> Listening -> Thinking (customer turn) -> Speaking (answer segment) -> Thinking (between segments) -> Listening. Ended appears when ending is requested; Error appears on startup/fatal issues. React also tracks active and ending: Ended while summary is pending is different from fully finalized with busy=false. Server begins Connecting; Idle is UI-only. Audio callbacks can also update displayed Thinking/Speaking.

Server JSON events all include session_id:
  session: assigns this call UUID.
  state: contains the state label.
  speech_start: chunk_id plus sample_rate=24000.
  speech_done: chunk_id; provider delivery is complete, browser playback may still run.
  transcript: contains a typed Entry.
  tool: contains registered tool name and structured result.
  error: message plus fatal boolean.
  summary_pending: announces outcome preparation. The current hook has no dedicated handler; requested end already set ending=true.
  ended: final transcript array, validated/deterministic outcome and fallback boolean.
Server binary frames carry raw PCM. Browser binary frames carry complete WAV containers.

Client JSON controls are end, played or playback_failed. Event requires session_id string at most 80 characters, optional chunk_id at most 80, and forbids extra fields. JSON controls are limited to 2000 characters. A played/failure event without chunk_id validates but cannot acknowledge speech. Wrong session_id or a disallowed/missing Origin closes with code 1008. Missing provider configuration or full capacity sends a fatal error and closes with 1013.

Playback evidence is the central distinction. Text generation or receipt of TTS bytes does not prove completed browser playback. say keeps intended words in pending and waits on a Future. checkDone requires speech_done, no remaining speaker nodes, nonempty sample count and no incomplete byte. The browser then sends played. Only acknowledge adds Aria's words with playback='played'. Failure/end records an interruption marker, excluding full unconfirmed words. This proves browser playback completion, not that a human heard or understood the sound, device volume was audible or hardware was connected.

Customer entries are final STT text rather than partial captions. Server timestamps are UTC ISO strings, displayed in browser local time. turn_id groups a customer entry and several Aria answer segments. Greeting uses turn_id='greeting'; speech chunk IDs are UUIDs. session_id identifies the whole call, turn_id one interaction, and chunk_id one spoken segment. Their scopes are different.

Roman Hindi: 
Normal sequence Idle, Connecting, greeting Speaking, Thinking, Listening, customer turn Thinking, answer Speaking, segments ke beech Thinking aur phir Listening. End request par Ended; startup/fatal par Error. Active aur ending alag flags; summary pending Ended fully finalized nahi. Server Connecting se start, Idle UI-only. Audio callbacks displayed Thinking/Speaking badal sakte hain.

Har server JSON mein session_id. Session call UUID; state label; speech_start chunk/rate; speech_done provider delivery complete; transcript Entry; tool name/result; error message/fatal; summary_pending preparation; ended final transcript/outcome/fallback. Hook summary_pending ka dedicated handler nahi, end pehle ending true kar chuka. Server binary PCM, browser binary full WAV.

Client end, played aur playback_failed controls hain. Session ID required maximum 80, chunk optional maximum 80, extra fields reject. JSON 2000 characters. Chunk bina played speech acknowledge nahi karta. Wrong session ya missing/disallowed Origin code 1008; missing configuration/capacity fatal aur 1013.

Core playback truth: model text ya audio bytes milne se completed playback prove nahi. Say pending words aur Future rakhta hai. Browser speech_done, saare nodes finish, nonempty samples aur no half-byte par played bhejta hai. Tabhi acknowledge actual Aria words played Entry banata hai. Failure/end par marker aur unheard words omitted. Yeh browser playback complete hone ka proof hai; human hearing/understanding, volume ya hardware ka proof nahi.

Customer final STT entries hain, partial captions nahi. UTC ISO server time UI local dikhati hai. Turn ID customer aur uske answer segments group karti hai. Greeting turn greeting, chunk UUID alag. Session poori call, turn ek interaction aur chunk ek spoken segment identify karta hai.

9. SUMMARY, FALLBACK AND DATA LIFETIME
====================================================================================================
English: 
Backend summary runs when stop(notify=true) is requested. If no Customer entry exists, it returns deterministic NO_CONVERSATION with fallback=false; no AI summary was necessary. Otherwise facts_from_tools extracts unique canonical IDs and application-generated audit actions. A clear not-found lookup ID can be included as attempted lookup evidence. llm.summary requests JSON matching Outcome.model_json_schema. Pydantic requires all fields, forbids extras and checks membership of a nonempty primary ID/intent.

The backend waits at most 20 seconds. Model IDs absent from tool records are rejected. It then replaces order_ids with audit IDs, chooses primary order_id only for a single unique ID, replaces actions_taken with actual audit descriptions, and downgrades RESOLVED to PARTIALLY_RESOLVED if had_error. It validates again after replacement. Intent and resolution are still model interpretations of supplied evidence; there is no deterministic proof of every summary sentence or customer satisfaction.

On any exception, fallback returns unknown primary intent and an empty intents list. IDs/actions come from recorded tools; primary ID exists only for one unique ID. Recognized customer conversation means UNRESOLVED, otherwise NO_CONVERSATION. Summary states the recognized customer-turn count and unavailability reason; unresolved_questions contains at most the last three customer messages. A lookup alone never proves resolution or a business mutation. fallback=true labels AI generation/validation failure.

Browser localOutcome is used on unexpected disconnect or missing final server outcome after 30 seconds. It knows only entries/tools already received. It uses the same conservative unknown-intent/resolution approach, but actions contain only order lookups, unlike backend return-check audits. Identical browser lookup action strings are not currently deduplicated. It cannot recover unreceived server entries. A final server ended event replaces the UI transcript with the authoritative final list, including pending interruption markers.

Data lifetime: Agent history, Call.entries and Call.tools live in one Python process. Current browser refs/view also live in memory; a fresh call clears them. Optional downloads use local Blob URLs. No database, localStorage, sessionStorage or transcript files are implemented. Raw input WAV and output PCM are processed in memory and sent to the provider, not saved as application audio files. Interactions requests set store=false, which does not establish all account-level retention terms. Server restart/disconnect cannot resume old call history; received browser evidence remains available for a local fallback.

Roman Hindi: 
Backend summary notify true stop par banti hai. Customer entry nahi to deterministic NO_CONVERSATION aur fallback false; AI summary ki zaroorat nahi thi. Tools se unique canonical IDs aur actual audit actions nikalte hain. Clear not-found ID attempted lookup evidence ho sakti hai. LLM Outcome schema JSON maangta hai; Pydantic required fields, no extras aur primary membership validate karta hai.

Maximum 20-second wait. Tool records mein absent model IDs reject. Actual IDs aur actions overwrite, single unique ID par primary order, had_error par RESOLVED partial; dobara validation. Intent aur resolution model interpretation hain; har summary sentence ya customer satisfaction ka deterministic proof nahi.

Exception par fallback primary intent unknown aur intents empty. Tool IDs/actions, single ID par primary. Customer conversation ho to UNRESOLVED, warna NO_CONVERSATION. Summary turn count aur reason; aakhri teen customer messages unresolved questions. Lookup se resolution ya business action prove nahi. Fallback true AI generation/validation failure label hai.

Browser localOutcome disconnect ya 30-second final wait ke baad sirf received entries/tools use karta hai. Conservative intent/status, lekin audit sirf order lookups; backend return-check audit bhi deta hai. Duplicate browser lookup strings abhi deduplicate nahi. Unreceived entries recover nahi. Final server event aaye to authoritative transcript UI replace karti hai, pending interruption markers samet.

Agent history, transcript aur tools ek Python process memory mein. Browser refs/view memory mein aur nayi call clear. Optional downloads local Blob. Database, localStorage, sessionStorage ya transcript files nahi. WAV/PCM memory se provider ko jati hai, app audio files save nahi. Store false sab account retention terms ka proof nahi. 10. TIMEOUTS, LIMITS, ERRORS AND CLEANUP
====================================================================================================
English: 
Limits traced to actual code:
  Sessions: default 8 per backend process; valid setting range 1-100 (config.py:14).
  Total call: 900 seconds / 15 minutes (main.py:56).
  Idle receive: at most 180 seconds without a client packet (main.py:61).
  Customer submissions: 80 validated audio submissions; the 81st is rejected (session.py:173-176).
  Entire customer turn: 120 seconds for STT, model/tool rounds, TTS and playback waits combined (session.py:140).
  One speech segment acknowledgement: 60 seconds (session.py:96).
  HTTPX provider timeout: 45 seconds for the configured request phases, not a universal total-call deadline (gemini.py:19).
  Retry: one additional attempt after 0.5 seconds for the first 500, 502, 503 or 504 response. No 429 retry and no automatic replay after streaming output begins (gemini.py:23-27,35-43).
  Backend summary: 20 seconds (summary.py:42).
  Browser health fetch: 8 seconds; session receipt: 10 seconds; final outcome: 30 seconds (useCall.ts:110,118,82).
  Input WAV: greater than 44 and at most 4,000,000 bytes; mono, 16-bit, uncompressed; 8,000-96,000 Hz; 0.1-21 seconds; complete declared frame data (voice.py:10-23).
  TTS segment: at most 4,000,000 decoded PCM bytes (session.py:88).
  Text controls: 2,000 characters; transcription: 4,000 characters (main.py:68; session.py:146).
  Tool argument JSON: 4,000 characters; model text: 8,000 characters; response steps: 32; tools per round: 4; model rounds: 4 (agent.py; tools.py).

call_error distinguishes timeouts, network failures, HTTP 429 quota/rate limits, invalid credentials, model access and temporary provider outages. A 429 body mentioning daily or per day explains the daily reset and explicitly says replacing the key is unnecessary. HTTP 401 or an explicit API_KEY_INVALID response indicates credential rejection. Other 400 responses indicate a request/model-capability issue; 403/404 indicate access or model-name problems; 5xx indicates a temporary provider issue. These are the application's mappings, not a live diagnosis performed by this documentation task.

Three consecutive provider/playback failures become fatal; a completed successful turn resets failures to zero. Greeting failure is immediately fatal. Invalid WAV produces a nonfatal error without incrementing the provider failure counter. The 81st validated audio submission is fatal. fail sends an error/state but does not itself call stop or close the socket. Ordinary frontend fatal-error handling sends end and completes cleanup; a custom client that ignores this path is still subject to receive and total-call limits.

Browser cleanup begins before waiting for summary: set ending, stop microphone tracks, stop playback nodes, close AudioContext and stop the duration timer. stopPlayback can send playback_failed so unconfirmed speech is not labelled played. Server stop marks ended, cancels and awaits the current task, adds an interruption marker for pending speech, summarizes if connected, closes the two provider adapters and returns the slot. main's finally closes the socket. Unmount increments version before releasing resources so callbacks from a removed call cannot overwrite a newer one. Failed turns roll back model history and reconstruct it only from recognized Customer entries and played Aria entries. A disconnected call stops with notify=false and closes clients without attempting a summary delivery to a lost recipient.

Roman Hindi: 
Actual code ki limits: default 8 calls per process, setting range 1-100; total call 15 minutes; client packet bina idle wait 3 minutes; maximum 80 valid audio submissions. Poore customer turn ko STT, model/tools, TTS aur playback milakar 120 seconds milte hain. Ek segment ke played acknowledgement ka wait 60 seconds hai. HTTPX ka 45-second timeout request phases ke liye hai; poori call ka universal timer nahi. Pehli selected 5xx response par aadhe second baad sirf ek retry; quota 429 ya output shuru hone ke baad retry nahi. Backend summary 20 seconds, browser health 8 seconds, session 10 seconds aur final outcome 30 seconds tak wait karte hain.

Text control 2000 characters, transcription aur tool JSON 4000, model text 8000, steps 32, ek round mein tools 4 aur model rounds 4 hain.

12. SOURCE-BASED FINDINGS AND PRACTICAL LIMITATIONS
====================================================================================================
English: 
1. Configuration readiness is a shape check: any nonempty string not starting your- or sk- can pass. /health status ok proves application liveness, not valid credentials, remaining quota or model compatibility.
2. Orders are public fictional fixtures. Origin/CORS checks, per-socket UUIDs and size limits are not customer authentication or order authorization. active_calls is per process and is not coordinated across workers.
3. Mandatory order lookup before every order answer is a prompt instruction. run_tool strictly validates/allowlists tool execution, but there is no independent sentence gate that blocks an order claim which skipped a lookup. Live reasoning and injection resistance require separate evaluation.
4. Shipping/COD facts are model knowledge, with no registered deterministic calculators. Python return/cancellation rules duplicate constants in JSON, creating a future consistency risk. ORD-102's fourteen-day age is hardcoded by ID, not derived by a general timestamp system.
5. Fixed RMS detection is sensitive to quiet speech, noise and long pauses. There is no barge-in, resume, partial STT captions, guaranteed Hindi/Hinglish capability or measured latency target. Indian-English style is a request, not proof of a guaranteed native accent.
6. Agent yields one sentence; Call.turn awaits its TTS and playback before consuming further model deltas. This serial coordination maintains playback evidence but can increase turn time. The 120-second turn budget includes these playback waits.
7. Sentence boundaries use punctuation followed by whitespace. Abbreviations, decimals and unusual formatting may split imperfectly. Initial text in step.start is buffered, with later delta processing or stream end handling the sentence delivery.
8. Incoming browser server JSON is parsed without a dedicated malformed-message catch or runtime schema validation. TypeScript contracts alone do not validate received data. Unexpected event shapes can throw or behave incorrectly.
9. A fatal fail changes state and informs the browser but does not itself stop the server Call. Normal frontend end handling and other deadlines complete cleanup. A played event without chunk_id cannot resolve the speech Future and can cause a timeout.
10. Summary IDs/actions are grounded in the tool audit; intent and resolution still depend on model judgment. Browser fallback has a smaller action audit and only knows received data. A not-found ID represents an attempted lookup, not an existing order.
11. Model names and Google request shapes are source declarations. This task did not verify current external API availability or fetch external docs. The frontend interprets output as little-endian PCM; actual provider compatibility remains a runtime check.
12. next-env.d.ts references .next/dev generated type files. A clean checkout depends on framework type generation; existing generated output can mask that dependency during local typechecks. Build/cache artifacts are not authored implementation.
13. Server/browser history is memory-only; disconnect/restart has no resumable history. Optional JSON downloads are the user persistence mechanism. store=false does not establish all account-level provider retention terms.

These are source-analysis findings, not fixes performed by this request. Deployment URL, repository/video/profile links and remaining real-microphone checks in the original submission notes still need project-owner completion.

13. COMPLETE AUTHORED FILE-BY-FILE AND LINE-BY-LINE EXPLANATION
====================================================================================================

15. QUICK REVISION, GLOSSARY AND FINAL CHECKLIST
====================================================================================================

ASGI
English: Async interface used by Uvicorn to serve FastAPI HTTP/WebSockets.
Roman Hindi: Uvicorn aur FastAPI ke async HTTP/WebSocket serving ka interface.

STT
English: Speech-to-text: WAV bytes to recognized customer words.
Roman Hindi: Audio speech se recognized customer text.

LLM
English: Model reasoning/text generation with tool-call proposals.
Roman Hindi: Model text aur reasoning; tool calls propose karta hai.

TTS
English: Text-to-speech: one answer segment to PCM bytes.
Roman Hindi: Answer text se bolne wali PCM audio.

PCM
English: Numerical audio samples, here expected mono signed 16-bit little-endian.
Roman Hindi: Numerical audio samples; yahan expected mono signed 16-bit little-endian.

WAV
English: Container containing PCM plus rate/channel/header metadata.
Roman Hindi: PCM ke saath rate, channel aur header metadata wala container.

RMS
English: Square root of mean squared samples used as simple voice-energy threshold.
Roman Hindi: Samples ke squares ka average aur square root; simple voice-energy threshold.

AudioWorklet
English: Browser audio-thread processor that sends batches to the UI thread.
Roman Hindi: Browser audio thread processor; batches UI thread ko bhejta hai.

SSE
English: Server-sent event framing used between Google and HTTPX, separate from browser WebSocket.
Roman Hindi: Google-HTTPX ka server-sent event framing; browser WebSocket se alag.

Future/ack
English: Server awaitable resolved by actual browser played/failure event.
Roman Hindi: Server ka waiting result jise browser played/failure complete karta hai.

Half-duplex
English: Input and agent output are alternated, with no voice barge-in.
Roman Hindi: Customer input aur agent output bari-bari; voice barge-in nahi.

Origin/CORS
English: Browser cross-origin restrictions; not customer authentication.
Roman Hindi: Browser cross-origin restrictions; customer authentication nahi.

Fixture
English: Fixed fictional assessment data, not a live service result.
Roman Hindi: Fixed fictional assessment data; live service result nahi.

Fallback
English: Evidence-only outcome when an AI/server summary is unavailable.
Roman Hindi: AI ya server summary unavailable par sirf evidence wala outcome.

Grounding
English: Constraining facts/actions to recorded tool evidence and transcript.
Roman Hindi: Facts/actions ko recorded tool evidence aur transcript se jodna.

Hydration
English: React attaches browser behavior to initial rendered markup.
Roman Hindi: Initial markup par React browser behavior attach karta hai.

Roman Hindi: Revision flow: Start, mic, health, socket admission, actual greeting, playback ack, Listening, utterance detection, WAV, STT, customer transcript, model/tools, sentence TTS, played transcript, Listening, End, turant media stop, task cancel, validated summary ya fallback aur cleanup.

Fixed orders come from an allowlisted read-only lookup, standard-return/cancellation eligibility is deterministic Python, and played acknowledgements keep the transcript from claiming unheard speech. Structured summaries are validated and grounded in the tool audit, with explicit factual fallback on failure.
Roman Hindi: Interview mein bol sakte hain: Yeh browser voice-support demo hai jiska backend STT/LLM/TTS chain use karta hai. Fixed orders read-only allowlisted lookup se aate hain; return/cancellation eligibility Python rules se. Playback acknowledgements ke baad hi speech transcript mein confirm hoti hai. Structured summary validate aur tool audit se grounded hoti hai; failure par labelled factual fallback milta hai.
